question: ________ won silver at the Fide World Blitz Chess Championship, becoming the first Indian woman to win a medal at the prestigious event in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Koneru Humpy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first Indian woman to win the World Rapid Chess Championship 2019 title is Koneru Humpy__.
 
• She is India's youngest woman chess grandmaster player.
 
• In 2003, she was awarded Arjuna Award while in 2007, she was awarded Padma Shri.
 
• In 2015, she won a bronze medal in the Women's World Team Chess Championship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ** Vantika Agrawal **is also an Indian chess player who has** won several national and international championships**.

 
 
• However, she did not win a medal in the Fide World Blitz Chess Championship in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Bhakti Kulkarni** is another Indian chess player who has represented India in** several international tournaments.**
 
 
• However, she did not win a medal in the Fide World Blitz Chess Championship in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Rameshbabu Vaishali **is an Indian chess player who has won several national and international championships.
 
 
• However, she did not win a medal in the Fide World Blitz Chess Championship in 2022.
